trials.claim: Team Plan is a lifetime subscription paying once
trials.claimQuote: Brand2Social Lifetime Subscription – Team Plan - 25 Social Accounts - Unlimited Scheduled Posts
trials.reasoning: The terms describe recurring billing and renewal for subscriptions generally, but do not mention the lifetime deal or show deal buyers being billed repeatedly. No exhibit confirms a one-time lifetime Team Plan.

exhibits.quote: Subscriptions are billed in advance on a recurring and periodic basis (“Billing Cycle”). Billing cycles may be set on a monthly or annual basis, depending on the chosen subscription plan.
exhibits.argument: Terms define all subscriptions as recurring monthly or annual billing with no lifetime option, contradicting a one-time lifetime Team Plan.

exhibits.quote: Your Subscription will automatically renew under the same conditions at the end of each Billing Cycle, unless you cancel it or Brand2Social cancels it.
exhibits.argument: Automatic renewal clause shows the vendor contemplates ongoing billing cycles and unilateral cancellation, undermining a perpetual lifetime entitlement.

exhibits.quote: Subscriptions are billed in advance on a recurring and periodic basis (“Billing Cycle”). Billing cycles may be set on a monthly or annual basis, depending on the chosen subscription plan.

exhibits.quote: Brand2Social may, at its discretion and at any time, adjust Subscription fees for the Subscriptions.
